title: Streak definition (streaks/<name>.json), format version 1
description: One streak that a mod defines. The key names are listed in include/match/modload/streak_definition_keys.hpp; a test compares both. A streak is a counter that the engine updates from client events. The value of a streak is public to every seat, so a matcher, uni:group_by, and uni:value_field may read a payload field with the audience all only (semantic check streak.field.audience). A mod defines ids only in its own namespace, and only the uni mod defines uni: ids (loader check streak.id.namespace).

uni:format_version.description: Version of the file style. This build reads major version 1.

uni:identifier.description: Full streak id, namespace:name. The namespace is the id of the defining mod.

uni:type.description: run counts consecutive matches, total counts all matches, last_value stores a payload field of the last match and of the one before it.

uni:group_by.description: A payload field of the matched event with the audience all. The streak keeps one count for each value.

uni:value_field.description: last_value only: the payload field to store.

uni:reset_on.description: A run only: an event that matches one of these matchers sets the count to 0.

uni:tests.description: All tests must be true for the event to match.
